gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of primary triple negative breast carcinoma (TNBC).

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] Peptide (neoantigen) pulsed autologous Dendritic cell: Intradermal vaccination with peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cells in 200 µL of patient's serum in six doses, one weekly after surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients who have already been treated, either with chemo/radiotherapy and/or surgery regimens

role_evidence.quote: with six doses of peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cells after surgery

agents.drug_class_hint: personalised neoantigen peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccine

source_quote.quote: The chemical synthesis of at least one tumor NEOANTIGEN expressed exclusively by your tumor was successful.

coder_notes: Triple-negative breast cancer vaccine trial; glioblastoma mentioned only in the brief summary as a possible future application, so not_glioblastoma. Only intervention is a dendritic-cell vaccine (excluded type). Neoantigen requirement is linked to the vaccine, which is not a candidate, so not candidate-matched.
